esim.title: My eSIMs
esim.syncedStale: Last updated {time} — could not reach the network since
esim.installNowHint: Opens your phone's eSIM setup. Keep Wi-Fi on while it installs.
esim.installUnavailable: This phone cannot open the eSIM installer. Scan the QR code from another screen instead.
esim.scanHint: Or scan this code from another screen: Settings › Mobile service › Add eSIM.
esim.emptyBody: eSIMs you buy show up here, with how to install them.
esim.noPlans: No plans on sale here right now.
esim.perDayNote: {price} for {days} days, then {perDay} for each extra day. The cart shows the exact total.
esim.topupNone: No top-up is on offer for this plan right now.
esim.topupUnavailable: The network could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
esim.topupStackNote: The data and days are added to your current plan.
esim.topupAddonNote: This is a separate package beside your current plan, with its own data and days.

topupRefusal.not_supported: This plan cannot be topped up.
topupRefusal.not_issued: This eSIM has not been issued yet.
topupRefusal.expired: This plan has expired and can no longer be topped up. Buy a new eSIM instead.
topupRefusal.used_up: This plan's data is used up and it can no longer be topped up. Buy a new eSIM instead.
topupRefusal.profile_expired: This eSIM is no longer valid. Buy a new eSIM instead.

esim.payWaitingText: We are waiting for the payment to be confirmed. Some payments take a few minutes; your order appears in your orders as soon as it arrives.
esim.redirectNote: You will finish paying on the payment page, then come back here.
